column2: In Un- games, this also means the text boxes themselves are exchanged, including the flavor text and watermarks in those text boxes.
column3: Silver-border play only (CR 100.7; CR 612.5: "In games involving certain cards that aren't covered by these rules, other elements of the text box may also be exchanged."): in Un- games the flavor text and watermarks are exchanged along with the rules text. Neither is part of the game state the engine models, and the cards that refer to them (Plot Armor, Secret Base, Stamp of Approval, Phoebe, Head of S.N.E.A.K., ...) are not legal in any format (deferred, docs/DEFERRED.md). The ruling's other sentences (each creature loses its rules text and gets the other's; in both cases a text-changing effect, not a copy effect) are cited and tested by tests/rulings/r_p175_ring_and_text.rs (exchange_of_words_exchanges_rules_text)
